description: Chart one monitor's average response time over time, one series per region, to see where it is slow and since when. Returns monitor_id, window, bucket_seconds and regions, each with region, display_name and points (oldest first, the same buckets in every series: bucket_start, avg_response_time_ms, null when the bucket had no successful check, and sample_count). Every configured region has a series, even an empty one, followed by removed regions that still had checks; points start at the window's start or at the monitor's creation. For uptime use get_uptime_summary; for single checks use list_check_results.

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

window.description: 24h (the default; up to 24 hourly buckets), 7d (up to 28 six-hourly buckets) or 30d (up to 30 daily buckets).

name: get_response_time_by_region
title: Get a monitor's response time by region
